i18_INTRO_SSS_TBV_21: Any red diamonds that fall into the red Vault may trigger the JACKPOT Choose feature. The JACKPOT Choose feature will display 15 cards, and you can click on a card to reveal it. The card will show either a Jackpot card or an Upgrade card. When three identical Jackpot cards are revealed, the corresponding prize is awarded. If 3 Upgrade cards are revealed before hitting the JACKPOT, the prize won will upgrade to the next level. This feature ends once the player wins a prize. There is a five-second consideration time for the "JACKPOT Choose" feature. If no card is clicked within five seconds, the system will automatically select until a win occurs.
